messages.subject: Error in importing .txt file
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to import new point transect data and am having trouble with the .txt file. 

Everything looks normal when I open the file in note pad, but when I import it to Distance a few rows have been added to the end of preceding ones, doubling the number of necessary columns (see attached photo, right column).

You can also see that there is nothing in the lefthand column. There should be a '1' in each cell, but it disappears after the very first row (this is of minor concern to me at the moment).  

I have tried going through the .txt file and making sure there aren't any tabs missing, or generally anything that looks 'off' and I can't find any reason why it should be doing this.

I would be eternally thankful for some help!

Regards (and happy new year!),

Lauren

messages.author: fc98df0ed215166f
messages.subject: Re: Error in importing .txt file
parts: Update: the problem is the the .txt file was created on a Mac, which does not quite translate to PCs. If you are a Mac user, I would suggest transferring your excel file to a PC and creating a .txt file from there. The text files need to be Windows-specific, not Unix-specific.
